title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
abstract: arXiv:2610.10590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of USD 1.28-1.44 versus approximately USD 4.38. translated_title: 面向工具使用型智能体的智能体可控遗忘：可逆上下文整理的实践
translated_abstract: 工具使用型智能体反复携带的观测内容，其有用信息量可能远小于原始载荷。我们研究“智能体可控遗忘”：由执行模型选择先前观测到的工具结果，将其替换为位于原位置的简短笔记，并把精确的原始内容保存在可恢复的归档中。一个 Python 框架提供批量归档与显式恢复功能，无需针对特定任务的模型训练，同时保护用户指令和助手消息免受这些操作影响。在一个探索性的 OpenTelemetry 调试案例以及随后一个无关的实现任务中，该方法最终使用了 231,951 个由提供商报告的提示词令牌，而保留完整历史的方案为 912,492 个；累计输入令牌减少了 50%，估计的 API 成本为 1.28–1.44 美元，而完整历史方案约为 4.38 美元。两种方案均通过了双案例的主要行为测试；两者都未能完全满足后续评估。该方法使得更多……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“智能体可控遗忘”机制——由执行模型将旧的工具观测结果替换为原位的简短笔记并把原始内容存入可恢复归档，无需任务特定训练即可将提示词令牌从约91万降至约23万、累计输入令牌减少50%、API成本降至约三分之一，同时通过主要行为测试。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces agent-controlled forgetting, a reversible context-curation method in which the acting model replaces past tool observations with in-place short notes while archiving recoverable originals, cutting prompt tokens from ~912k to ~232k and API cost by roughly two-thirds without task-specific training.
